import re
passage = 'STK11 mutation was positively associated with CD8-/IFNG+ in LUAD'
options = ['CD8-/IGNF -', 'CD8- / IGNF+', 'CD8+/IGNF -', 'CD8+/IGNF +', 'Eosinophils/endothelial', 'Fibroblast/TGFβ']
def phenotype(text):
    m = re.search(r'CD8\s*([+-])\s*/\s*(IFNG|IGNF)\s*([+-])', text)
    return m.groups() if m else None
reported = phenotype(passage)
print('reported:', reported)
for letter, option in zip('ABCDEF', options):
    parsed = phenotype(option)
    signs_match = parsed is not None and (parsed[0], parsed[2]) == (reported[0], reported[2])
    exact_marker = parsed is not None and parsed[1] == reported[1]
    print(letter, 'signs_match:', signs_match, 'exact_marker:', exact_marker)
print('Interpretation: B alone matches both signs; no option exactly matches the IFNG spelling.')

import re

}

    print(enzyme, 'sites:', len(found), 'zero-based starts:', found)
cuts = sum(len(found) for found in sites.values())

print('Complete digest, circular:', cuts, 'fragments (D)')
